page: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 105 MB of L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show strong performance in single-threaded tasks, with Geekbench single-core scoring 2074.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 33.6 GB/sec. The processor's advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX) support high-throughput operations, reflected in a strong Passmark CPU encryption test score of 35678.6. Multi-core performance is solid, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 35034.78 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 15951.0. Memory bandwidth is measured at 162.39 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 83.85 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes. For lightweight machine learning workloads, the server achieves an LLM inference speed of 286.26 tokens/sec for text generation using a small 135M model.

The c7i-flex instance family is designed to deliver a cost-effective entry point for compute-intensive workloads by utilizing a flexible resource allocation model. This makes it highly efficient for workloads that require high CPU performance but do not continuously saturate all resources. The combination of DDR5 memory, dedicated Intel Xeon cores, and advanced instruction sets makes this server well-suited for batch processing, static web serving (which achieved a strong throughput of 51.12 GB/sec), software compilation, and moderate database operations.
description: Amazon Web Services c7i-flex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) from an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of high-speed 5 GHz DDR5 memory. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. Benchmark data highlights strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2074.0 and strong single-threaded gzip compression of 33.6 GB/sec. It also supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX, enhancing cryptographic and vector processing. The c7i-flex.8xlarge provides a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads that experience variable utilization, making it highly suitable for software compilation, static web serving, batch processing, and moderate database operations.
